title: ⭐ Pressure [V12]
description: Former holy grail of the Ye community. This version has Travis Scott doing the bridge and harmonizing over the "Get Off Me" interlude along with the "clear search history" line cut. Originally thought to have been from Turbo Grafx 16, though this version at the very least is from SWISH sessions. Short recording of Che Pope playing the song over Instagram Live surfaced on October 23rd, 2020. The main melody is sampled from "Haunted" from the Maniac Soundtrack. Also contains a minute long intro sample from the 2012 film Silver Linings Playbook. Stem bounce leaked after Luit sold the song in a $25k groupbuy, which finished in just under 9 hours with the support of multiple unreleased communities providing bonuses and donations. Later released on VULTURES 2 DIGITAL DELUXE 5 with vocals from Ty Dolla $ign and a punch-in on the line "You the type of nigga shop at Uniqlo, just found out my father-in-law unisex", following the popularity of the leak.
